title: Today's top defense-tech headlines
big: 30 new stories since the last brief. The busiest areas: allies & theaters and adversaries: china, russia, iran.

stories.h: Senate Appropriators Cut $20B from Navy Shipbuilding Request
stories.what: Lawmakers are pushing back on the Navy’s shipbuilding plans by cutting funding for several high-profile programs and reducing the shipbuilding budget by nearly $20 billion.
stories.you: The Navy is short of ships and is turning to cheaper unmanned boats, which opens the door to new builders.

stories.h: MDA Seeks AI Tools to Modernize Legacy Missile Defense Software
stories.what: MDA's software office is targeting Ada, C and older C++ for automated refactoring in the NOBLE-based MASM effort.
stories.you: Software that decides what to look at and what to hit is where the most value is moving.

stories.h: Appropriators slash Trump’s $17B Golden Dome request in draft bill
stories.what: GOP-led committee says reliance on reconciliation “threatens” the missile defense program’s success.
stories.you: Missile defense is one of the biggest budget lines this decade, and its software and sensors are open to newcomers.

stories.h: A $1.1 trillion Pentagon budget plan sets up a fight on Capitol Hill
stories.what: Senate appropriators are prioritizing Golden Dome, drones and munitions, but other military programs could pay the price.
stories.you: Budget and policy moves decide which programs get real money and when; they're the earliest signal of demand.

stories.h: Ukraine plans to double drone supplies, triple deep strikes
stories.what: Ukraine is forging ahead with its long-range strike campaign with support from European partners, despite Washington’s request to prioritize front-line defense and associated midrange strikes instead.
stories.you: Drones are becoming the military's default purchase, so volume, price and reliability decide who wins.

watch.h: Stopgap funding expires: FY27 appropriations or another CR
watch.why: December 11. Decides whether DAWG's $54.6B and Golden Dome's growth become real money.

idea.h: Tactical power and thermal systems for directed energy
idea.why: Batteries, power conditioning and cooling packs that let lasers and microwave weapons fire continuously on vehicles. Laser production has started (AeroVironment E-HEL) but fielding is slow (Iron Beam); power and cooling are the constraint.
